# Expert Market Research

> Expert Market Research (Claight Corporation) provides comprehensive market intelligence, procurement insights, price forecasting, and custom consulting solutions across industries.

Expert Market Research is a leading market research and business intelligence firm offering syndicated reports, custom research, patent landscape analysis, procurement intelligence platforms, and data analytics services. The company serves global clients across healthcare, commodities, manufacturing, and enterprise sectors with tools like Procure360 and MI 360 for market and procurement intelligence.

## Core Services & Solutions

- [Expert Market Research Services | Core Competencies](https://www.expertmarketresearch.com/service-listings/core-competencies): Overview of Expert Market Research's core competencies and service offerings

- [Procurement Insights & Trends](https://www.expertmarketresearch.com/procurement-insight): Procurement intelligence platform for supply chain and commodity pricing analysis
- [Price Forecast Report](https://www.expertmarketresearch.com/price-forecast): Price forecasting service for commodities including petroleum coke and fly ash
